system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The decision agent then operates based on the current task progress, current screen state, and the reflection (if the last operation is erroneous).
system_prompt_style.note: No Mobile-Agent-v2 code in the bundle. Per-step inputs (task progress, memory, reflection, perception) imply per-step recomposition. The analogous PC-Agent prompt.py uses conditional sections.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value. The visual perception output (OCR plus icon info) is injected each step; this is not a file tree. Mismatch recorded for Ambiguities.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The planning agent condenses lengthy, interleaved image-text history operations and screens summaries into a pure-text task progress

observation_format.evidence_quote: Ot = DA(Ins, T Pt−1, F Ct−1, Rt−1, St, Pt)
observation_format.note: St is the screenshot; Pt is the text perception result.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space.
tool_call_format.note: Closest value. Actions are text function-like strings such as Tap (x, y); the parser is not in the bundle.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Stop. If the decision agent thinks that all requirements have been fulfilled, it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.
tool_count.note: Counted from the paper: Open app, Tap, Swipe, Type, Home, Stop.

edit_primitive.note: The operation space lists no file-editing operation; this is a GUI-only agent.

protocol_standardization.note: The Mobile-Agent-v2 source and dependencies are not in the bundle. The MCP mentions are for other subprojects.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the reflection agent observes the outcomes of each operation and handles any mistake accordingly.
loop_primitives.note: Iterative per-step loop with a reflection check and a re-execution of the operation.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The task progress includes the sub-tasks that have already been completed.
planning_granularity.note: The task progress text is stored and re-read each iteration. No code was available to confirm a data structure.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The three agent roles work respectively in the progress, decision, and reflection stages, collaborating to alleviate the difficulty of navigating.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After generating the task progress, the planning agent passes it to the decision agent.

human_in_loop.note: No v2 run loop or config in the bundle. Manual knowledge injection is an input hint, not a gate.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The memory unit serves as a short-term memory module that is updated as the task progresses.
short_term_state.note: State consists of the task progress and the memory unit, both beyond the message list.

long_term_memory.note: No v2 code in the bundle. The memory unit is within-run only.

state_persistence.note: No v2 code in the bundle.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we design the reflection agent to observe the screen state before and after a decision agent’s operation to determine whether the current operation meets expectations.
self_verification.note: The reflection agent is a separate MLLM call. It uses the same GPT-4V model, so self_critique is arguable.

retry_policy.note: Only step-level re-execution is described. Task-level retry is not reported.

rollback.evidence_quote: If erroneous operation, the page will revert to the state before the operation.
rollback.note: GUI state revert with an unspecified mechanism. Closest value; mismatch recorded.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Stop. If the decision agent thinks that all requirements have been fulfilled, it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.
termination_condition.note: Other caps are not reported; the v2 run loop is not in the bundle.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We used Android Debug Bridge (ADB) as the tool for operating mobile devices.
execution_isolation.note: Actions execute on a real phone via ADB. Closest value; mismatch recorded.

eval_hooks.note: The evaluation code in the bundle is for Mobile-Agent-v3 (android_world), not v2.
